policy.compatibility: Additive metric_id vocabulary in measurement-record.v1, not a claim that producers exist

checks.title: Favicon and tab identity

metrics.note: Only if permitted asset probe completed
Optional platform enhancement, not a mandatory failure

checks.verdict_rule: Assess title separately; usable icon evidence is link declaration with valid asset or an observed permitted /favicon.ico fallback. Brand match requires validated brand reference or human review.
non_claims: A declared icon alone is not proof of browser display
Missing apple-touch-icon alone is not a defect

checks.title: Social link preview metadata

metrics.note: Only if external resource safety allows a successful fetch

reuse.pxapi: META_DESCRIPTION_PRESENT and page identity, without conflating og:description

checks.verdict_rule: Check four OGP base properties, then optional description/image metadata and permitted image delivery. Social platform preview is not guaranteed by markup.
non_claims: 1200x630 is a practical design target, not a universal protocol condition
WhatsApp sharing appearance cannot be proven from markup alone

checks.title: Unknown-route error experience

metrics.note: Optional; not every website needs a contact link on 404

reuse.pxapi: HTTP_STATUS transport facts; DO NOT parse error documents as selected-page content
reuse.skill: UX-08 applies to feedback states; no new core weight

checks.verdict_rule: A safely probed non-existent route should normally return 404; observe whether recovery navigation is available. A generic but usable 404 is not automatically defective. Distinguish blocked / intercepted fetch from site response.
non_claims: An HTTP 404 is not by itself poor UX
HTTP 200 with missing-page content is a soft-404 candidate, not a proven Google Search Console verdict

checks.title: Image alternative markup

reuse.pxapi: New observations only; semantic judgement is separate

checks.derived_kpi: alt_markup_coverage_pct = 100 * (IMG_ALT_EMPTY_COUNT + IMG_ALT_NONEMPTY_COUNT) / IMG_ELEMENT_COUNT when IMG_ELEMENT_COUNT > 0; NULL otherwise
checks.verdict_rule: An absent alt attribute is a markup observation; alt="" can be correct for decorative images. Informative / functional appropriateness needs context or review.
non_claims: Alt markup coverage is not semantic alt quality
No images does not mean 100% accessibility

checks.title: Loading, errors and recovery feedback

reuse.pxapi: requires future RenderedPagePort and bounded scenario policy
reuse.skill: UX-08, A11Y-02 as relevant; no extra core weights

checks.verdict_rule: Only evaluate scenario-specific states actually triggered in authorized non-mutating browser conditions. No safe trigger or no browser equals NOT_ASSESSED. ARIA/live messages are judged in the context of WCAG status messages.
non_claims: No UI transition triggered does not mean feedback is absent
No synthetic error injection against production unless explicitly authorized
